summary: Aptorum Group Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval of a merger with DiamiR Biosciences Corp. At an EGM on June 9, 2026, Aptorum's shareholders voted overwhelmingly to approve the merger, share consolidation, domestication from Cayman Islands to Delaware, stock issuance (>20%) to DiamiR stockholders, a new stock incentive plan, and director appointments. All proposals passed with over 99.8% support. DiamiR shareholders also approved the merger on the same day. The transaction is structured as a reverse triangular merger where Aptorum will form a Delaware Merger Sub to merge into DiamiR, with DiamiR surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. No price per share or premium was disclosed. This filing indicates the merger is on track to close, pending regulatory and other customary conditions.
